name: pull-request-mapper
description: Map stacked PR inheritance into a Mermaid flowchart using the GitHub CLI.

commands.title: PR Mapper: Upsert Diagram to Current PR Description

enumDescriptions: Omit closed and merged PRs from the stack diagram (open only).
Include closed and merged PRs, styled gray in the Mermaid diagram.
Include closed and merged PRs with the same styling as open PRs.
pullRequestMapper.closedPullRequests.description: How closed and merged pull requests appear in the stack diagram.

pullRequestMapper.maxDepth.description: Maximum dependent levels below the stack root (0 = unlimited). Root is level 0.

pullRequestMapper.excludeDrafts.description: When true, omit draft pull requests from the diagram.

pullRequestMapper.authorFilter.description: If non-empty, only include PRs authored by this GitHub login.

pullRequestMapper.labelFilter.description: If non-empty, only include PRs that have this label name.
